finance.title: Imari
finance.description: Gucunga ibikorwa by'imari, ibaruramari, n'ingengo y'imari

dashboard.title: Ikibaho cy'imari
dashboard.incomeVsExpensesChartTitle: Amafaranga yinjira na yakoreshwa (Amezi 6 ashize - Urugero)
dashboard.hubDescription: Gukurikirana ibikorwa byose by'imari, harimo gucunga amafaranga y'ishuri, amafaranga akoreshwa, ihuza ry'imishahara, n'raporo.
dashboard.enhancementNote: Ikibaho cyakunzwe n'imibare y'ingenzi, imbonerahamwe, n'ihuza ryihuse.

banks.title: Gucunga amakonti y'amabanki
banks.description: Gucunga amakonti y'amabanki y'ishuri. Buri konti ya banki igomba guhuza na konti y'umutungo mu mbonerahamwe y'amakonti.
banks.glAccountLabel: Guhuza na konti y'umutungo ya GL
banks.deleteConfirm: Uzi neza ko ushaka gusiba iyi konti ya banki?
banks.alertRequiredFields: Izina rya banki na konti ya GL birakenewe.

chartOfAccounts.title: Gucunga imbonerahamwe y'amakonti
chartOfAccounts.description: Gucunga imbonerahamwe y'amakonti y'ishuri. Sobanura amakonti y'umutungo, amadeni, ubwigenge, amafaranga yinjira, n'amafaranga akoreshwa.
chartOfAccounts.expenseCategoryLabel: Icyiciro cy'amafaranga akoreshwa (ku bwoko bw'amafaranga akoreshwa)
chartOfAccounts.deleteConfirm: Uzi neza ko ushaka gusiba iyi konti? Ibi bishobora kugira ingaruka ku makonti y'amabanki ahuye cyangwa inyandikorugero z'amafaranga y'ishuri.
chartOfAccounts.alertRequiredFields: Kode ya konti, izina, ubwoko, n'ubwoko bw'inyandikorugero birakenewe.

financialYears.title: Imyaka y'imari
financialYears.description: Imyaka y'imari ihuriza hamwe ibihembwe, amafaranga ya shuri na konti. Intera z'amatariki ntizishobora guhura, kandi umwaka umwe ufunguye ni wo mwaka uriho.
financialYears.name: Izina
financialYears.closeMessage: Funga {{name}}? Imyaka ifunze ikomeza kuboneka mu raporo ariko ntabwo ikiri iyo ubu.
financialYears.lastOpenHint: Kora cyangwa wongere ufungure undi mwaka w'imari mbere yo gufunga uyu.
financialYears.emptyDescription: Ongeraho umwaka w'imari ibihembwe n'amafaranga yawe bihererwa.

feeStructures.title: Gushyira mu bikorwa imyubakire y'amafaranga (kora inyandiko z'ubwishyu z'abanyeshuri)
feeStructures.description: Shyira mu bikorwa inyandiko z'amafaranga y'igihe cy'ishuri ku banyeshuri bayo. Inyandiko zikoreshwa ku byiciro by'abanyeshuri n'ingero; buri munyeshuri ahabwa inyandiko imwe ku gihe, kandi kongera gukora byongeraho gusa ibibura. Banza urebe, hanyuma ukore.
feeStructures.summary: Inyandiko nshya {{created}}, zihinduwe {{updated}}, zisanzwe zishyuwe {{skipped}}, nta nyandiko ihuye {{unmatched}}. Igiteranyo KES {{amount}}

invoiceGeneration.title: Gukora inyandiko z'ubwishyu
invoiceGeneration.description: Shyira mu bikorwa inyandiko zose z'amafaranga z'igihe cyatoranyijwe ku banyeshuri bakora zikwiye (ku rwego n'icyiciro cy'umunyeshuri). Buri munyeshuri ahabwa inyandiko imwe ku gihe; kongera gukora byongeraho gusa ibibura.
invoiceGeneration.unmatched: Abanyeshuri bakora {{count}} nta nyandiko y'amafaranga ihuye n'igihe cyabo.
invoiceGeneration.configureMessage: Hitamo igihe, reba mbere ibijyanye n'ubwishyu, hanyuma ukore inyandiko z'ubwishyu

fines.validation: Umunyeshuri, igihe cy'ishuri n'amafaranga arenze zeru birakenewe.

generalReceipts.itemsRequired: Buri kintu kigomba kugira ibisobanuro, amafaranga yemewe na konti y'inyungu.
generalReceipts.payerNameRequired: Izina ry'uwishyura rirakenewe ku bwoko bw'uwishyura "Ikindi".

transportRoutes.validation: Izina ry'inzira, ikiguzi cyemewe ku gihe, na konti y'inyungu GL birakenewe.
